      <div data-fluid-engine="true"><style></style><div class="fluid-engine fe-6855511dd4453a6dd403f8d1"><div class="fe-block fe-block-ad323d55d4db993d71e7"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="ad323d55d4db993d71e7" id="block-ad323d55d4db993d71e7"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Kitesurf Room</strong></h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><em>Freshly Renovated • Private Deck • Ideal for Water Enthusiasts</em></strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The Kitesurf Room is a comfortable, fully renovated space designed for guests who want easy access to the water and a quiet corner to unwind afterward. Located near the Roatán Kite School and just steps from the beach, this room offers simplicity, privacy, and a relaxed connection to the sea.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Inside, you’ll find a queen bed (convertible into two twin beds with advance notice) and a spacious, modern bathroom featuring handmade Honduran cement tiles and a custom-crafted sink. Natural materials and soft colors give the room a calm, clean feel that complements the East End breeze just outside.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Double doors open onto your own intimate private deck overlooking the Caribbean Sea and the grassy launch area used for rinsing and drying gear after a session on the water. This terrace is one of the most private outdoor spaces at the Lodge — perfect for stretching out in your hammock, enjoying a quiet moment, or reading after a day of exploring.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">While the room sits close to the restaurant and bar for easy meals, its orientation and tucked-away design create a peaceful retreat with plenty of personal space. Air conditioning is available for added comfort.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Ideal for couples, friends, or small families — whether you plan to kite, paddle, dive, or simply enjoy the calm of Camp Bay — the Kitesurf Room offers comfort, privacy, and effortless access to everything the East End has to offer.</p></div>
